items.title: File Widerspruch against rejection of disability pension
items.quote: dafür steht ab der Bekanntgabe ein Monat zur Verfügung.
items.computation: Sender is a statutory pension insurance carrier (social-law body under SGB X), not a tax office, so the 4-day delivery fiction (§ 37 Abs. 2 SGB X) applies without weekend/holiday shift. Letter dated (posted) Wednesday 29.09.2027; no separate 'zur Post gegeben am' date is stated, so posting day = document date. Counting 4 calendar days: 30.09, 01.10, 02.10, 03.10 → deemed delivery Sunday 03.10.2027 (not moved, since only tax-office deliveries shift for weekends/holidays). The one-month Widerspruch period (§ 84 SGG) runs from delivery: per §§ 187, 188 BGB the delivery day is not counted, and the period ends on the day in the following month bearing the same number as the delivery day → 03.11.2027. That date (Wednesday) is not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in NW, so no further shift under § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X / § 64 Abs. 3 SGG applies.
